dashboard.importReport.title: Import reports
dashboard.importReport.intro: Your rules are active as soon as a valid identifier is saved. This view follows background channel-detail completion and highlights rows that need review.
dashboard.importReport.description.needs: Automatic completion has stopped for this row—usually “channel does not exist,” terminated/deleted, a name-only entry, or a queue inconsistency. The rule remains active unless you remove it.
dashboard.importReport.description.retry: YouTube returned a temporary error or incomplete metadata; the rule remains active and will be tried again.
dashboard.importReport.description.pendi: The row is waiting for its first paced lookup.
dashboard.importReport.description.fetch: This is the one channel lookup currently running.
dashboard.importReport.description.compl: The UC ID, channel name, handle/custom URL, and avatar are available.
dashboard.importReport.summary.visibleNo: Showing the first {shown} rows. Use search or Show more to narrow the list.
dashboard.importReport.guidance.permanen: Verify this identifier on YouTube or replace it with an exact channel URL/UC ID. The saved rule remains active until you change or remove it.
dashboard.importReport.guidance.manualVe: Verify the imported value manually, then replace it with an exact channel link or UC ID.
dashboard.importReport.guidance.provideE: Provide an exact channel link to replace a name-only or invalid row.
dashboard.importReport.reason.incomplete: Some channel details are still missing. FilterTube will try again.
dashboard.importReport.reason.temporaryE: YouTube returned a temporary error. FilterTube will try again.
dashboard.importReport.reason.fetchFaile: YouTube did not return channel details. FilterTube will try again.
dashboard.importReport.reason.metadataUn: YouTube did not provide complete channel details.
dashboard.importReport.reason.timeout: YouTube took too long to respond. FilterTube will try again.
dashboard.importReport.reason.channelNot: YouTube could not find this channel.
dashboard.importReport.reason.channelDel: YouTube reports that this channel was deleted.
dashboard.importReport.reason.channelTer: YouTube reports that this account was terminated.
dashboard.importReport.reason.channelUna: YouTube reports that this channel is unavailable.
dashboard.importReport.reason.savedRuleM: The saved rule is no longer present in this target.
dashboard.importReport.reason.nameOnly: This is a name-only rule. Add a channel link or UC ID if you want exact channel identity and metadata.
dashboard.importReport.reason.notVerifie: YouTube could not verify this channel identifier.
dashboard.importReport.reason.fetching: Channel details are being fetched now.
dashboard.importReport.reason.metadataNo: The rule is active, but its incomplete metadata is not currently queued.
dashboard.importReport.reason.waitingInQ: The rule is active; channel details are waiting in the paced queue.
